title: How can I make the player’s flashlight not go through walls? (Community Lighting MZ )

posts.author: ratasoftware
posts.body:
Hi everyone!!!!
I’m using the
Community Lighting plugin (Terrax)
in
RPG Maker MZ
, and everything works fine except for one problem: the
player’s flashlight passes through walls
.
I’d like to make the flashlight stop at walls or obstacles, but I can’t figure out how to configure this. I’ve checked the plugin parameters and documentation, but I don’t see anything related to wall collision or light blocking.
How can I set up the map so that the flashlight doesn’t shine through walls?
I’d really appreciate any help or examples from someone who has managed to do this. Thanks in advance!
PD: I tried this...
